message.content:
In /opt/nxeon-staging, the Minecraft game server panel currently has separate tabs for Players, Inventory, and Roles. The user wants these combined into a single "Players" tab with sub-sections.

Current files:
- `components/customer/gamepanel/GamePlayers.tsx` — online player list with kick/tp/gamemode
- `components/customer/gamepanel/GameInventory.tsx` — item slot editor per player 
- `components/customer/gamepanel/GameRoles.tsx` — LuckPerms roles/permissions management
- `components/customer/gamepanel/GameServerPanel.tsx` — the tab container (TABS array + rendering)
- `components/customer/gamepanel/types.ts` — PanelTab union type

What to do:

1. Create a new `components/customer/gamepanel/GamePlayersHub.tsx` that:
   - Has 3 internal sub-tabs: "Online Players" (default), "Inventory", "Roles & Permissions"
   - Sub-tabs should be small pill buttons at the top, styled similarly to the main tab bar but smaller
   - "Online Players" renders the existing `GamePlayers` component
   - "Inventory" renders the existing `GameInventory` component  
   - "Roles & Permissions" renders the existing `GameRoles` component
   - Props: `serverId: string`, `running: boolean`, `playersMax: number | null`

2. In `GameServerPanel.tsx`:
   - Remove the separate `inventory`, `roles`, and `players` tabs from the TABS array
   - Keep only `{ key: "players", label: "Players" }` (remove `mc?: true` from it — it should show for all games; the sub-tabs for inventory/roles only render when `isMc`)
   - Import and render `GamePlayersHub` for the "players" tab instead of the current three separate renders
   - Pass `isMc` as a prop so the hub knows whether to show inventory/roles sub-tabs
   - Remove the old imports for GamePlayers, GameInventory, GameRoles (GamePlayersHub will import them)

3. In `types.ts`:
   - Remove `"inventory"` and `"roles"` from the PanelTab union (keep `"players"`)

IMPORTANT: 
- Do NOT modify GamePlayers.tsx, GameInventory.tsx, or GameRoles.tsx themselves
- The existing components stay exactly as they are, just wrapped in the new hub
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` at the end to verify no type errors
- Use the same Nxeon styling: dark theme, white/10 borders, brand-500 accent, slate-400 text
